title: docs(qa): re-point records-forms.field-history-tracking to the record page v3 sys_audit_log gate; the live history spec reads the Changes chip
body:
Fixes #27492

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：把清单条目 `records-forms.field-history-tracking` 里还在找 History 标签页的三条断言，改指向记录页 v3 的真实形态：开了 trackHistory 的对象读 `sys_audit_log`，结果出现在时间线的「变更」筛选里；没开的对象不读。另外更新了夜间 live e2e 用例 `record-history-display.spec.ts`，它在主干上一直是红的。
- 为什么改：记录页 v3（#27055）在所有宽度下都去掉了 History 标签页，产品本身没问题。旧断言让每轮发版巡检都多一条假红，还会盖住同条目里的真红。
- 风险与回滚：只动了一份清单 JSON 和一个夜间 e2e 用例，不碰产品代码，也不进任何已发布的包。回滚就是 revert 这个 PR。
- 先看：`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json` 的 acceptance[2] 和新加的 knownGaps 第 2 条（任务详情页那一半的证据由两道闸门共同决定，单看它证明不了标志位）；然后看 `ui/e2e/live/record-history-display.spec.ts` 的视口和定位器。
- 两分钟验证：在本地起 showcase 和 console dev server，然后跑 `LIVE_APP_URL=… LIVE_API_URL=… pnpm --dir ui exec playwright test --config=playwright.live.config.ts record-history-display.spec.ts`。预期是 1 passed，旧版本会在等 History 标签页时超时。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

One item, `records-forms.field-history-tracking`, goes from revision 9 to 10. It is the only item edited, and the live spec it cites is updated with it. No product code changes.

- **acceptance[2]** no longer asks for a History tab. It now says the record page's `sys_audit_log` field-change history is gated on object-level `enable.trackHistory` in both directions. On the account, the page reads `sys_audit_log` and the timeline stream's Changes chip lists the tracked edits as old → new lines with display values. The task makes no `sys_audit_log` read. The **oracle moves from `dom` to `network`**, because the Changes chip cannot prove an absence: it also lists the stream's `sys_activity` created/updated rows (`ACTIVITY_TYPE_TO_FEED_TYPE` maps both to `field_change`).
- **negative[1]**: a `sys_audit_log` read on the task detail is a FAIL. It is judged on the network log, never on an empty Changes chip or a missing tab.
- **steps[3]** says where the stream sits in each width tier (`recordPageTierFor`): the timeline column, or the Activity card while the reader's timeline switch is off (the default for showcase_account), or the Timeline tab. It gives the measured widths. The steps no longer send the runner to look for a History tab.
- **negative[3]** was a cross-reference that could only ever score `skipped`. It moves out of `negative[]` into `source[4]`, the field sibling items already use for cross-refs (`access-security.*` carry 15+ "cross-ref …" rows in `source`). The checklist has no notes key, and none was invented.
- **automated.ref** now says what the re-pointed live spec holds: acceptance[2]'s flag-true DOM half, at 1440×900. It also says the read gate is still driven by hand in both directions.

Scope additions inside the same item, all the same stale-History-tab class, declared here because the claim's file surface did not list them:

- the **title** said "gates the History tab";
- **fixtures.requires[1]** said "the tab/op gating";
- **negative[0]** exempted "the History tab" from the per-field rule. It now exempts the stream's audit-log lines. On a trackHistory object those lines replace the stream's `sys_activity` updated rows (`mergeTimelineStream`). Without this change, a runner would FAIL a correct "Website old → new" line;
- **source[2]** still pointed at the objectui-era path and the "History tab gate";
- one **new knownGaps entry**. showcase_task's record page is the authored `kind: 'full'` `showcase_task_detail` page. RecordDetailView serves the audit read only to a synthesized page (`RecordDetailView.recordOpenWaves-13010.test.tsx`: "an assigned page of a trackHistory object never reads the audit log"). So the task's absent read holds with or without the flag. No showcase object pairs per-field flags, no enable block, and a synthesized page.

`ui/e2e/live/record-history-display.spec.ts` (nightly list, unchanged) now opens showcase_account at **1440×900**. It selects the Changes chip of the `Timeline` region and asserts the same display contract as before: real actor, option labels, localized dates, resolved owner. The page has no tab and no switch to click at that width. The unknown-user guard now matches the stream's `detail.unknownUser` fallback (`Unknown` / `未知用户`).

## Tests

All readings come from a showcase booted from this branch with `pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 38497` (backend) and the console vite dev server (`DEV_PROXY_TARGET` pointing at it, port 38581). The tree was base `882d4e4a5c` plus this diff, with no product code changed.

<details><summary>The spec at base, unchanged: red, for the reason the card names</summary>


The failure screenshot at its 1000×800 viewport shows two columns, details plus related, and no tab strip. The stream sits in the Activity card, with the chips All / Activity / Discussion / Changes. A temporary copy of the base spec was used for this run and then deleted.
</details>

<details><summary>The re-pointed spec: green, run twice on that boot</summary>

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The PM's premise correction (H1) does not hold.** #27473 moved this spec to 1000×800 to stay in the tabbed tier, where the History tab was assumed to still exist. It does not exist there. `buildDefaultTabs` emits Details / Timeline / Related / Approvals only, and `buildDefaultPageSchema.test.ts` asserts "no Activity or History tab". Live at 1000×800 the console sidebar comes up as its icon rail, the record view is 952 px, and the page draws two columns with no tab strip. Only a narrower window, measured at 700, reaches the tabbed tier. The spec has been red on the nightly list since the record page v3 change.
- **Card wording vs. tree.** The card asked that an untracked object show "no Changes entries". The tree contradicts that for any synthesized page, because the Changes chip also lists `sys_activity` created/updated rows. For showcase_task the stream is absent altogether, since its record page is authored. The item now follows the tree.
- Not filed, noted here. These are the same stale-History-tab family in sibling items and comments. None is a product defect.
  - `records-forms.crud-roundtrip` (rev 15): steps and acceptance[4].verify still say "open the record's History tab". This is the contract this item's cross-ref points at.
  - `records-forms.record-edit-undo` (rev 5): one verify still says "after screenshot of the History tab".
  - `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/account.object.ts`: the comment on `enable` still narrates the History tab.
  - #27312 already tracks the spec `describe()` of `enable.trackHistory`.
- acceptance[0].verify says "the timeline renders the same row". On a trackHistory object the stream drops the `sys_activity` updated row in favour of the audit entry (`mergeTimelineStream`). The text a runner sees is the same old → new pair, so this was left alone.
